p: bones of the king of Edom: For the Moabites were so cruel against the King of Edom, that they burnt his bones after he was dead: which declared their barbarous rage, that they would avenge themselves upon the dead.

I will not turn away the: Seeing that the Gentiles who did have as much knowledge were punished in this way, Judah which was so fully instructed by the Lord's will, should not think that they would escape.
Israel: If he did not spare Judah unto whom his promises were made, much more he will not spare this degenerate kingdom.
shoes: They esteemed most vile bribes more than men's lives.
dust of the earth on the: When they have robbed him and thrown him to the ground, they open wide their mouths for his life.
by every altar: Thinking that by these ceremonies, that is, by sacrificing, and by being near my altar, they may excuse all of their other wickedness.
drink the wine of the condemned: They rob others and offer it to God, thinking that he will exempt them, when he is made partaker of their iniquity.
Amorite before them: The destruction of their enemies and his mercy toward them, should have caused their hearts to melt because of love toward him.
your young men for Nazarites: You condemned my benefits, and abused my graces, and craftily went about to stop the mouths of my Prophets.
pressed under you: You have wearied me with your sins; Isa 1:14.
swift: None will be delivered by any means.
